From Dormant to Dominant.

Your honest Gym Bro.Anime physique workout . AI-powered

Awaken: Level Up Your Body is a gamified fitness app, workout tracker, AI workout planner, and training companion built to turn real workouts into a progression system.

Train. Track. Earn XP. Rank up. Build your body.

Your body is the vessel. Your training is the quest. Every workout becomes part of your fitness journey toward greater strength, muscle, performance, consistency, and confidence.

AI-Powered Personalized Workouts

Get personalized workout plans and structured training built around your goals, experience, schedule, available equipment, and current fitness journey. Awaken uses AI to help you know what to train and gives every workout a clear purpose.

Build muscle. Improve strength. Improve fitness. Stay consistent.

Workout Tracker & Training Log

Log real workouts, exercises, sets, reps, and performance. Keep your training history in one place and turn each completed session into measurable progression.

Awaken connects workout logging with an RPG-style progression system:

Workout → XP → Progress → Rank 

Track workouts, monitor fitness progress, build streaks, and keep moving toward your fitness goals.

Level Up Your Body

Earn XP, ranks, badges, achievements, and rewards as you train. Complete quests and turn consistency into visible progression.

Every session counts.

Keep training. Keep improving. Keep leveling up.

Anime-Inspired Fitness RPG

Awaken brings an anime-inspired System experience to real-world fitness.

Train like the main character. Complete daily quests. Earn experience. Unlock achievements. Build your stats. Rise through the ranks.

The fantasy is in the experience. The work is real.

Track Fitness Progress

See your workouts, training consistency, XP, ranks, badges, achievements, and streaks come together in your profile.

Know Your Starting Point

Optional AI-powered physique analysis can help you understand your current starting point and generate physique insights. Use your analysis as information about where you are today—not as a final score.

Your physique is your starting point. Your training is what changes it.

Train Anywhere

Build a routine around your environment. Train at the gym or at home. Use weight training, strength training, or bodyweight exercises. Follow a personalized workout plan that fits your goals and equipment.
